label: MacBook Pro 16-inch (M3 Max)
description: 16.2-inch M3 Max workstation laptop with three Thunderbolt 4 ports, HDMI and SDXC; Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3.
notes: Still no Ethernet jack despite the pro chassis - wired is Thunderbolt-dock only (1GbE or 2.5GbE dongle). Wi-Fi 6E is the sole native interface; a good contrast to the Mac Studio's built-in 10GbE.
